title: append_with_break puts the break kind and the page layout on the wrong section
symptom: Rust append_with_break writes the break kind on the destination's last section and gives the destination's pages Letter size, 1 inch margins and no header, so a continuous break starts a new page
workaround: Rust: insert_section at the end, set_break_type on the new section, then import_fragment the source body there with FragmentConflictPolicy::for_insert_document(None)
